lin (eng-runtime): quick follow-up from the allocator sync — proposing a lightweight slab-session primitive to reduce fragmentation for model loaders. idea: callers open a session, allocate many small tensors into the session, then end the session so allocator can pack them.

ashwin (eng-runtime): high-level API?

lin (eng-runtime): proto: StartSlabSession(tenant, tier, target_bytes) -> session_id, granted; AllocateFromSession(session_id, size, align) -> handle; EndSlabSession(session_id, mode) -> reclaim_hint. modes: COALESCE, RELEASE, CHECKPOINT.

noah (eng-ml): sounds good. SDK helper would be: with slab_session(bytes,tier,priority): allocate tensors. makes loader changes trivial.

sara (eng-sre): ops constraints: session_ttl, admin_force_drain, session_priority, revocable flag. telemetry: session_count, avg_lifetime, wasted_bytes_by_session.

lin (eng-runtime): rollout plan: 1) advisory sessions + metrics only; 2) SDK helpers & canary; 3) revocable sessions + compaction behind flags; 4) opt-in force-packing for Dedicated.

noah (eng-ml): compaction concerns: need budget so background packing doesn't spike GPU mem bandwidth. expose compaction_budget_pct per-tenant.

ashwin (eng-runtime): integrate with existing ReserveResident/HintResident by mapping a session to one large under-the-hood reservation when beneficial. simplifies fragmentation.

ops-bot: alert: staging node g3-5 fragmentation high; suggested action: evict low-priority sessions.

lin (eng-runtime): good signal. owners: lin -> API + allocator impl (ETA 3w), noah -> SDK + loader changes (ETA 1w), sara -> canary + alerts (ETA 2d). will push a short doc and state-machine diagram. ping here for objections. :rocket
